```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(tigris)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
options(scipen = 999)
```

---

## 1. Load and Prepare Data

```{r load}
panel <- read_csv("../data/processed/final_data_monthly.csv",
                  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

demo <- read_csv("../data/processed/cbg_demographics.csv",
                 col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character()))

# Cross-section with demographics
cross <- panel %>%
  group_by(GEOID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta_pm25   = mean(mean_delta_pm25,   na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_trips_worse   = mean(pct_trips_worse,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mobility_adj_pm25 = mean(mobility_adj_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    residential_pm25  = mean(residential_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_destinations    = mean(n_destinations,    na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_low_count     = mean(pct_low_count,     na.rm = TRUE),
    n_months          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(demo, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    log_median_income = log(median_income),
    state = case_when(
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "11" ~ "DC",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "24" ~ "MD",
      substr(GEOID, 1, 2) == "51" ~ "VA"
    )
  )

# Load shapefile
dmv_counties <- c("11001","24031","24033","51013","51059","51510","51600","51610")

cbg_shp <- map_dfr(c("DC","MD","VA"),
                   ~block_groups(state = .x, year = 2019, cb = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(substr(GEOID, 1, 5) %in% dmv_counties) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Complete cases for modeling
model_vars <- c("GEOID","mean_delta_pm25","pct_nonwhite",
                "log_median_income","pct_no_vehicle",
                "pct_college","residential_pm25","pct_low_count")

model_data <- cross[, model_vars] %>% drop_na()

cbg_sf <- cbg_shp %>% inner_join(model_data, by = "GEOID")

cat("Model sample size:", nrow(cbg_sf), "\n")

# Spatial weights
nb  <- poly2nb(cbg_sf, queen = TRUE)
lw  <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# KNN-5 for robustness
coords  <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(cbg_sf))
nb_knn5 <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 5))
lw_knn5 <- nb2listw(nb_knn5, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Standardized predictors for effect size comparison
cbg_sf <- cbg_sf %>%
  mutate(
    pct_nonwhite_z     = scale(pct_nonwhite)[,1],
    log_income_z       = scale(log_median_income)[,1],
    pct_no_vehicle_z   = scale(pct_no_vehicle)[,1],
    pct_college_z      = scale(pct_college)[,1],
    residential_pm25_z = scale(residential_pm25)[,1]
  )
```

---

## 2. Model Formulas

```{r formulas}
# Unstandardized — for interpretation in original units
base_formula <- mean_delta_pm25 ~ pct_nonwhite + log_median_income +
  pct_no_vehicle + pct_college + residential_pm25

# Interaction — primary model (M4)
interact_formula <- mean_delta_pm25 ~ pct_nonwhite * residential_pm25 +
  log_median_income + pct_no_vehicle + pct_college

# Standardized — for effect size comparison
std_formula <- mean_delta_pm25 ~ pct_nonwhite_z + log_income_z +
  pct_no_vehicle_z + pct_college_z + residential_pm25_z
```

---

## 3. RQ1/RQ2 — Spatial Model Selection

```{r m1-ols}
# M1: OLS baseline
m1 <- lm(base_formula, data = cbg_sf)
cat("--- M1 OLS ---\n")
print(summary(m1))

cat("\nMoran's I on OLS residuals:\n")
moran_ols <- moran.test(residuals(m1), lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
print(moran_ols)

cat("\nLagrange Multiplier tests:\n")
print(lm.RStests(m1, lw, test = "all", zero.policy = TRUE))
```

```{r m2-sem}
# M2: Spatial Error Model — base specification
m2 <- errorsarlm(base_formula, data = cbg_sf,
                 listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat("--- M2 SEM ---\n")
print(summary(m2))

cat("\nMoran's I on SEM residuals:\n")
print(moran.test(residuals(m2), lw, zero.policy = TRUE))
```

```{r m3-slm}
# M3: Spatial Lag Model — robustness check
m3 <- lagsarlm(base_formula, data = cbg_sf,
               listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat("--- M3 SLM ---\n")
print(summary(m3))

cat("\nSpatial impacts (direct / indirect / total):\n")
m3_impacts <- impacts(m3, listw = lw, R = 500)
print(summary(m3_impacts, zstats = TRUE, short = TRUE))
```

---

## 4. RQ3 — Interaction Model (Primary)

```{r m4-interact}
# M4: SEM with interaction — primary model
m4 <- errorsarlm(interact_formula, data = cbg_sf,
                 listw = lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
cat("--- M4 SEM Interaction (Primary) ---\n")
print(summary(m4))

cat("\nLR test M4 vs M2:\n")
print(lrtest(m4, m2))
```

```{r interaction-interpretation}
# Marginal effect of pct_nonwhite at different levels of residential_pm25
b_nw  <- coef(m4)["pct_nonwhite"]
b_int <- coef(m4)["pct_nonwhite:residential_pm25"]
q25   <- quantile(cbg_sf$residential_pm25, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
med   <- median(cbg_sf$residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)
q75   <- quantile(cbg_sf$residential_pm25, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

tibble(
  residential_pm25_level = c(
    paste0("Q25 (", round(q25, 2), " ug/m3) — suburban"),
    paste0("Median (", round(med, 2), " ug/m3)"),
    paste0("Q75 (", round(q75, 2), " ug/m3) — urban")
  ),
  marginal_effect_pct_nonwhite = round(c(
    b_nw + b_int * q25,
    b_nw + b_int * med,
    b_nw + b_int * q75
  ), 6)
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 10. Marginal Effect of pct_nonwhite at Different Residential PM2.5 Levels")
```

```{r marginal-effects-plot, fig.cap="Figure 11. Marginal effect of pct_nonwhite on mean_delta_pm25 across residential PM2.5 range. Effect shrinks in already-polluted areas — the spatial trap mechanism."}
res_range <- seq(min(cbg_sf$residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(cbg_sf$residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = 100)

# Standard error for interaction via delta method (approximate)
vcov_m4  <- vcov(m4)
se_int   <- sqrt(vcov_m4["pct_nonwhite", "pct_nonwhite"] +
                 res_range^2 * vcov_m4["pct_nonwhite:residential_pm25",
                                        "pct_nonwhite:residential_pm25"] +
                 2 * res_range * vcov_m4["pct_nonwhite",
                                          "pct_nonwhite:residential_pm25"])

marginal_df <- tibble(
  residential_pm25 = res_range,
  effect           = b_nw + b_int * res_range,
  lower            = effect - 1.96 * se_int,
  upper            = effect + 1.96 * se_int
)

ggplot(marginal_df, aes(x = residential_pm25, y = effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2, fill = "#d73027") +
  geom_line(color = "#d73027", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(q25, med, q75),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
  annotate("text", x = q25, y = max(marginal_df$upper),
           label = "Q25\nSuburban", size = 3, hjust = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = q75, y = max(marginal_df$upper),
           label = "Q75\nUrban", size = 3, hjust = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x     = "Residential PM2.5 (ug/m3)",
    y     = "Marginal Effect of pct_nonwhite",
    title = "Spatial Trap: Race Effect on Mobility Exposure by Residential Baseline",
    subtitle = "Effect of racial composition shrinks as residential PM2.5 increases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

## 5. RQ4 — COVID Period Comparison

```{r covid-split}
# Build pre-COVID and COVID era cross-sections
make_period_cross <- function(panel_data, years) {
  panel_data %>%
    filter(year %in% years) %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_delta_pm25  = mean(mean_delta_pm25,  na.rm = TRUE),
      residential_pm25 = mean(residential_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(demo %>% mutate(log_median_income = log(median_income)),
              by = "GEOID") %>%
    drop_na(mean_delta_pm25, pct_nonwhite, log_median_income,
            pct_no_vehicle, pct_college, residential_pm25)
}

pre_cross   <- make_period_cross(panel, c(2018, 2019))
covid_cross <- make_period_cross(panel, c(2020, 2021))

# Standardized predictors for each period
standardize <- function(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm=TRUE)

add_std <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    pct_nonwhite_z     = standardize(pct_nonwhite),
    log_income_z       = standardize(log_median_income),
    pct_no_vehicle_z   = standardize(pct_no_vehicle),
    pct_college_z      = standardize(pct_college),
    residential_pm25_z = standardize(residential_pm25)
  )
}

pre_cross   <- add_std(pre_cross)
covid_cross <- add_std(covid_cross)

std_base <- mean_delta_pm25 ~ pct_nonwhite_z + log_income_z +
  pct_no_vehicle_z + pct_college_z + residential_pm25_z

# Build spatial weights for each period
fit_period_sem <- function(cross_data, label) {
  sf_data <- cbg_shp %>%
    inner_join(cross_data, by = "GEOID") %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_delta_pm25))

  nb_p <- poly2nb(sf_data, queen = TRUE)
  lw_p <- nb2listw(nb_p, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  model <- errorsarlm(std_base, data = sf_data,
                      listw = lw_p, zero.policy = TRUE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$Coef) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    mutate(period = label,
           sig = case_when(
             `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
             `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
             `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
             TRUE ~ ""
           ))
  coef_df
}

cat("Fitting Pre-COVID SEM...\n")
pre_coefs <- fit_period_sem(pre_cross, "Pre-COVID (2018-2019)")

cat("Fitting COVID Era SEM...\n")
covid_coefs <- fit_period_sem(covid_cross, "COVID Era (2020-2021)")

# Combined coefficient table
bind_rows(pre_coefs, covid_coefs) %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") %>%
  select(period, variable, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `Pr(>|z|)`, sig) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 5))) %>%
  arrange(variable, period) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 11. Standardized SEM Coefficients: Pre-COVID vs COVID Era")
```

```{r covid-coef-plot, fig.cap="Figure 12. Standardized coefficients pre-COVID vs COVID era. Demographic gradients compressed during COVID."}
bind_rows(pre_coefs, covid_coefs) %>%
  filter(!variable %in% c("(Intercept)")) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = variable, color = period, shape = period)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
                  linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2166ac", "#d73027"),
                     name = "Period") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = "Period") +
  labs(
    x     = "Standardized Coefficient (±95% CI)",
    y     = NULL,
    title = "Coefficient Comparison: Pre-COVID vs COVID Era",
    subtitle = "Standardized predictors — coefficients are directly comparable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 6. Robustness Check — KNN-5 Weights

```{r m7-knn5}
m7 <- errorsarlm(base_formula, data = cbg_sf,
                 listw = lw_knn5, zero.policy = TRUE)

# Coefficient comparison
coef_m2 <- coef(m2)
coef_m7 <- coef(m7)
common  <- intersect(names(coef_m2), names(coef_m7))

tibble(
  variable = common,
  M2_queen = round(coef_m2[common], 5),
  M7_knn5  = round(coef_m7[common], 5),
  diff     = round(coef_m7[common] - coef_m2[common], 5)
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 12. Robustness Check: Queen Contiguity vs KNN-5 Weights")
```

---

## 7. Model Comparison Summary

```{r model-comparison}
# Extract coefficients helper
extract_coefs <- function(model, name) {
  if (inherits(model, "lm")) {
    cf <- summary(model)$coefficients
  } else {
    cf <- summary(model)$Coef
  }
  as.data.frame(cf) %>%
    rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
    mutate(model = name)
}

key_vars <- c("pct_nonwhite","log_median_income","pct_no_vehicle",
              "pct_college","residential_pm25","pct_nonwhite:residential_pm25")

bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(m1, "M1 OLS"),
  extract_coefs(m2, "M2 SEM"),
  extract_coefs(m3, "M3 SLM"),
  extract_coefs(m4, "M4 SEM+Interaction")
) %>%
  filter(variable %in% key_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.001 | `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
      `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.01  | `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
      `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05  | `Pr(>|t|)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    estimate_se = paste0(round(Estimate, 5), " (", round(`Std. Error`, 5), ")", sig)
  ) %>%
  select(model, variable, estimate_se) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = estimate_se) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 13. Model Comparison — Key Coefficients (SE in parentheses)")
```

```{r fit-summary}
tibble(
  Model          = c("M1 OLS", "M2 SEM", "M3 SLM", "M4 SEM+Interaction"),
  AIC            = round(c(AIC(m1), AIC(m2), AIC(m3), AIC(m4)), 1),
  LogLik         = round(c(as.numeric(logLik(m1)), as.numeric(logLik(m2)),
                            as.numeric(logLik(m3)), as.numeric(logLik(m4))), 1),
  Spatial_param  = c("—",
                     paste0("λ = ", round(m2$lambda, 3)),
                     paste0("ρ = ", round(m3$rho,    3)),
                     paste0("λ = ", round(m4$lambda, 3))),
  Primary        = c("", "", "", "✓")
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 14. Model Fit Summary")
```

```{r coef-plot, fig.cap="Figure 13. Coefficient plot for M2 SEM (base) and M4 SEM (interaction). Residential PM2.5 dominates; demographic effects significant after spatial correction."}
m2_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(m2)$Coef) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    model = "M2 SEM (base)"
  )

m4_coefs <- as.data.frame(summary(m4)$Coef) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    model = "M4 SEM (interaction)"
  )

bind_rows(m2_coefs, m4_coefs) %>%
  filter(variable != "residential_pm25") %>%   # exclude dominant term for scale
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = variable, color = model, shape = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
                  linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2166ac","#d73027"), name = "Model") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17), name = "Model") +
  labs(
    x     = "Coefficient (±95% CI)",
    y     = NULL,
    title = "Spatial Regression Coefficients — M2 vs M4",
    subtitle = "residential_pm25 excluded for scale (M2: -0.889, M4: -0.864)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
